description.value: Robson Wine Beer + Spirits is a 3,000 square foot specialty liquor retail store in the heart of downtown Vancouver, stocking an artisan-focused selection of BC craft beers, local estate wines, and small-batch spirits alongside international imports. Staff 'Guides' are available to help with selections, and in-store tasting is offered. Its location at Robson and Homer Streets makes it a convenient stop for touring cyclists seeking local BC beverages to take home or to their accommodation.
